final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT MediaTypeId AS m, AVG(UnitPrice) AS p, AVG(CASE WHEN Milliseconds = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (Bytes * 1.0) / Milliseconds END) AS r FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.m AS m, s1.p AS p, s1.r AS r, s1.r - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.a) SELECT AVG(p), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s3
